XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Misfiring during acceleration, with sporadic engine fault light illumination.

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Component: Ignition coil

  • Fault: Misfires occur during acceleration, whilst the engine runs smoothly at idle. The engine fault light comes on sporadically

  • Errors detected by the on-board diagnostics:
    • P0300 (Misfire in unspecified cylinders – Fault)
    • P0301 (Misfire in cylinder 1 – Fault)
  • Cause: Faulty ignition coil

• Action: Check that the ignition coil is working properly and replace it if necessary.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: In this case, the engine is equipped with a single ignition coil that controls the 4 spark plugs on the cylinders.
